claim: Man AHL describes momentum, mean-reversion and fundamental models alongside data science, machine learning and competing execution routes.
limitations: Firm description; not independent proof of a specific strategy return.

claim: Gu, Kelly and Xiu attribute tree/neural-network predictive improvements to nonlinear interactions; dominant signals include momentum, liquidity and volatility.
impact_on_spec: Test matched feature/model contribution rather than model branding.
limitations: Published historical research does not establish local net profitability or present execution.

claim: Ke, Kelly and Xiu learn news sentiment specifically for return prediction using Dow Jones Newswires.
impact_on_spec: Alternative text needs a financial target and a matched information baseline.
limitations: Different licensed corpus; does not validate local timestamps or certify an interchangeable SEC/news adaptation.

claim: AQR nonlinear market/factor timing examples challenge a universal small-model preference, but explicitly exclude transaction costs in the shown paper results and show sensitivity to noisy predictors.
impact_on_spec: Permit richer models when supported; require local costed and noise-control tests.
limitations: Hypothetical long-history examples, not current live evidence or a reason to transplant published performance.

claim: Man Numeric describes credit-card receipts, point-of-sales data and surveys used to nowcast Japanese retailer sales, then examines announcement-related stock returns.
impact_on_spec: Start with the business quantity and information advantage an alternative dataset measures.
limitations: Manager case study; sector-relative displayed returns are not an independently audited implementable net account.

claim: Carver self-reports a systematic futures CAGR of12.0% over his comparison history and a net-16.3% UK tax year ending April2025, with explicit commissions/slippage/margin attribution.
impact_on_spec: Benchmark reproducible account attribution, varied return sources and cost control.
limitations: Self-reported, not independently audited here. Benchmark comparators are adjusted to his higher volatility; date bases differ. Not a full-calendar2025 result.

claim: Official standings list Kevin Davey2005 second148.0%,2006 first106.7%,2007 second111.6%.
impact_on_spec: Selected contest records establish that high gains occurred in those accounts, not a typical individual return distribution.
limitations: Does not disclose a reproducible complete strategy, full risk or all accounts.

claim: The organizer states entrants may trade multiple competition accounts and competition results need not represent all accounts controlled by an entrant.
impact_on_spec: Do not use selected winning accounts as representative whole-wealth returns.
limitations: This bounds inference; it does not negate the recorded account result.

claim: Davey advocates positive-expectancy tested strategies diversified across markets, timeframes and trend/mean-reverting approaches.
impact_on_spec: Evaluate strategy contributions and a costed combined account, not only a single optimized rule.
limitations: Educational/commercial source; examples are not independently verified live portfolio performance.

claim: Boehmer,Huszar,Jordan2010 study positive information in low-short-interest heavily traded stocks, contrasting it with potentially transient high-short-interest negative returns.
impact_on_spec: Motivates a conditional factor/interaction contribution, not another DTC threshold gate.
limitations: Institutional abstract opened; publisher full page403. Historical results do not establish current application.

claim: Short interest is outstanding short positions at dated snapshots, distinct from daily short sale volume.
impact_on_spec: Preserve field semantics in factor comparison.
limitations: 2021 explanatory notice; current and historical publication clocks must be verified from their actual records.

claim: Current consolidated short-interest API documentation says data are available by4:40PMET on publication date.
impact_on_spec: Use actual stored publication and next-session visibility, never settlement-date visibility.
limitations: Current API statement does not certify historical arrival timestamps or create a new entitlement.
